objective: Generate production app-lib Cabal dependencies from reviewed reachable imports instead of every registered package

dependency_authority.interpretation: Cabal declaration authority narrowed to packages required by reachable source imports. The production GHC environment intentionally still supplies transitive packages so ghc-pkg can validate mappings and Cabal can resolve legitimate transitive availability; it is no longer used as declaration authority.

managed_ihp_seam.module_package_validation: Every mapped external module is checked with ghc-pkg find-module; the declared package must be one of the exposing production packages.

matched_12_core_profile.interpretation: The app-library build closure is effectively unchanged because the same transitive GHC environment remains available. Matched RSS and cgroup growth improved about 3.5%, while wall time worsened 15.36% in one shared-host run; neither is overstated. This was a first clean build of the candidate derivation, so no separate rebuild determinism check ran. The durable result is bounded Cabal authority and a smaller final runtime closure.

negative_probes.undeclared_import: Adding import Acme.UndeclaredProductionDependency to Main.hs failed production-inventory-check with the module and Main.hs via Main provenance.
negative_probes.wrong_package_mapping: Mapping Codec.Archive.Zip to aeson failed the production build before compilation and reported that zip-archive exposes the module.
